description: This file defines an internal interface IActivationRebalancerWorker for Orleans rebalancing, including methods for retrieving reports, resuming, and suspending rebalancing operations.

classes.name: IActivationRebalancerWorker
classes.description: An internal interface for managing activation rebalancing in Orleans, providing methods to get reports, resume, and suspend rebalancing.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Returns the most recent rebalancing report and acts as a wake-up call for the rebalancer.

methods.name: ResumeRebalancing
methods.description: Resumes rebalancing if it is currently suspended.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Suspends rebalancing for a specified duration or indefinitely if null.
